name: CB Survival Extract
summary: Advanced helicopter extraction system for FiveM survival servers.
description: CB Survival Extract is a configurable helicopter extraction system designed for FiveM survival and post-apocalyptic servers. It features route-based helicopter extractions, dynamic extraction costs, secure server-side payment validation, interactive NUI menus, configurable helicopter models, and optional SQL logging. The system supports ESX, QBCore, QBox, and Standalone environments, with multiple inventory integrations including ox_inventory, qs_inventory, core_inventory, tgiann-inventory, and ashenlabs_inventory. Additional features include customizable notifications, target or key-based interactions, Discord webhook logging, multilingual support, and modular integration hooks for developers.
